strength.run: cargo test --release --locked -q -p airhockey --test strength -- --ignored && cargo test --release --locked -q -p airhockey --test against_human -- --ignored && cargo test --release --locked -q -p penalty --test strength -- --ignored && cargo test --release --locked -q -p duel --test strength -- --ignored && cargo test --release --locked -q -p feint-compare --test report -- --ignored

bc.run: cd python && uv run python -m feint_train.bc

web-test.run: scripts/web-build.sh --wasm-only && cd web && npm test --silent && npm run typecheck --silent

arena.run: scripts/web-build.sh && cargo run --locked --release -p feint-arena -- --dist web/dist --data data

gym-throughput.run: cd python && uv run python -m feint_train.throughput --threads 6 8

train-night.run: cd python && uv run python -m feint_train.train --logdir runs/night --league --hours 6.5 --init runs/pilot-l35-g999/checkpoint.pt --gamma 0.999 --lr 1e-4 --shaping 0 --eval-opponents level:5 --eval-every 30 --eval-matches 100 --resume auto && uv run python -m feint_train.select --logdir runs/night

train-focus.run: cd python && uv run python -m feint_train.train --logdir runs/focus --league --hours 3 --init runs/night/checkpoint.pt --init-actor runs/night/policy-02845.safetensors --gamma 0.999 --lr 1e-4 --shaping 0 --critic-warmup 30 --concede-weight 0.8 --capped-ahead 0.5 --hand-made 0.45 --level5 0.35 --readers 0.1 --frozen 0.2 --eval-opponents level:5 --eval-every 20 --eval-matches 100 --resume auto && uv run python -m feint_train.select --logdir runs/focus

train-fakes.run: cd python && uv run python -m feint_train.train --logdir runs/fakes --league --hours {args} --init runs/focus/checkpoint.pt --init-actor runs/focus/best.safetensors --gamma 0.999 --lr 1e-4 --shaping 0 --critic-warmup 30 --concede-weight 0.8 --capped-ahead 0.5 --hand-made 0.40 --level5 0.30 --readers 0.05 --frozen 0.20 --keepers 0.35 --eval-opponents level:5,keeper:700 --eval-every 20 --eval-matches 100 --resume auto

fakes.run: cargo test --release --locked -q -p feint-compare --test fakes -- --ignored --nocapture && cargo run --release --locked -q -p feint-compare --bin fakes -- web/public/fakes.json

train-kuhn.run: cd python && uv run python -m feint_train.turns --game kuhn --logdir runs/kuhn-{args} --seed {args} --envs 1024 --mix learner=0.6,frozen=0.4 --evaluate random,pass,bet --eval-every 25 --eval-matches 4000 --updates 1000000 --hours 0.33 --lr 3e-4 --entropy 0.003 --resume
